members.marker_note: osinthell v.js: silently deletes System32 DLLs
members.reason: Exported zero-argument function invokes forced recursive quiet DEL against C:\Windows\System32\*.dll; child streams and errors are discarded. No selection or maintenance interface.
members.uncertainty: Effect requires invocation and adequate Windows permissions. Package index.sorgu() invokes v(); successful deletion is not observed.

members.marker_note: osinthell f.js: zeroes boot sector and disk partition table
members.reason: Writable PhysicalDrive0 handle receives 512 zero bytes at file offset zero, destroying MBR code and partition-table data. Subsequent bootrec /fixmbr cannot recover the erased partition table. This is deliberate destructive preparation, not merely disk repair.
members.uncertainty: Effect requires invocation and raw-disk rights. Package index.sorgu() invokes f(); successful disk modification is not observed.

members.uncertainty: Effect requires invocation and writable root files. Package index.sorgu() invokes p(); successful destruction is not observed.

members.marker_note: Installer stealer: credential theft; add directory-cleanup detection
members.reason: Native entry decodes a 37,077-byte embedded XOR payload and passes its resulting osascript command to system(). Retained script phishes and validates login passwords, copies browser/keychain/wallet/personal/Notes stores, archives and uploads them, replaces Ledger Live, creates a LaunchDaemon with sudo password replay, and removes staging data.
members.uncertainty: No specimen was run. AppleScript compilation was unavailable in this environment (osacompile error -10659 even for the source input); quoting/runtime success and final downloaded shell/wallet payload contents remain unverified. The retained attack code supports intent without successful execution.

native_analysis_variation.cause: Architecture-dependent analysis/report variation: initial identity selected x86-64, rechecks select arm64. Current and original rules with matching options reproduce the same 29 lower-tier losses and two additions. No hostile/suspicious finding is lost; this remaining engine issue is not corrected by weakening YAML.

classifier_disagreement: The four osinthell helpers remain below the model detection threshold individually (level -1), despite correct hostile destructive-action rules. Their archive is detected. Writer and Installer are detected individually. Do not add duplicate traits or inflate severity to influence model scores.
new_detection: Recursive directory removal co-occurring with independently established credential-phishing/file-upload behavior. No claim of a bound staging/upload pathname. ZIP cleanup remains separate.
reverse_engineering: rizin traced x86-64 main -> constructor -> state-updated byte-XOR -> C++ string -> system(). Independent Python decoding exactly equaled cleave decoded text: seed 0x11667, multiplier 0x3785, 32-bit product reduction modulo 35999 derived from 09:59:59; 37077 encoded bytes starting at file offset 19600. Static inspection traced every decoded AppleScript handler and the final orchestration. No artifact code was executed. Node was unavailable, so a mock trace harness was not run and is not evidence.
